title: Spec 015 Tenant current-main audit convergence evidence

phases.objective: Validate current-main Tenant reuse and candidate PR evidence as deterministic read-only audit artifacts without reconstructing candidates or granting runtime mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Spec 015 audit artifact regression from the exact candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The reuse matrix, candidate snapshot, convergence posture, and no-mutation flags pass deterministic validation against one current-main SHA.
steps: Parse the current-main field-level reuse matrix and verify all 11 logical entity rows have allowed audit statuses and existing evidence paths.
Parse the nine-record candidate PR snapshot and verify exact identities, shared snapshot base SHA, read-only flags, and no secrets.
Verify candidate convergence remains draft_review_required and reconstruct-on-current-main rather than blindly merged.
Run Spec 015 contract validation and the tenant audit artifact regression without database, provider, Cloudflare, or Production access.
assertions: The reuse matrix is complete as an audit artifact but does not grant canonical authority or runtime readiness.
All candidate records share the exact current-main base SHA and have safe_read_only=true, merge_executed=false, and secrets_included=false.
The convergence contract remains draft_review_required with do_not_blind_merge_reconstruct_on_current_main posture.
No database migration, provider write, Cloudflare change, Production mutation, or candidate merge is executed.
